title: Illustration / Shape language / Color palette
slide_intent: Balance a common palette with subject needs because consistency should not prevent an illustration from communicating its subject.
strategic_value: A broad family of named colors can keep Duolingo drawings related while accommodating varied characters and objects.
demonstration: Named swatches with hexadecimal values fill a tall pale panel, progressing through neutrals, warm colors, greens, blues and purples; a note explains flexibility.
practical_value: Use the illustration palette as a general guide while preserving the source’s permission to add a needed color.

content_islands.name: Palette reference
content_islands.spec: Group the named swatch cards by color family in the broad left panel, retaining every printed hex value.

content_islands.name: Flexibility note
content_islands.spec: Place the Color heading and explanation at upper right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The swatch families demonstrate the breadth of the illustration palette.
reference_purposes.Application: Named swatches and hexadecimal values supply repeatable color references.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source explicitly calls this a general guide and allows a color outside the palette when an illustration needs it.

ingredient.name: Illustration palette
ingredient.role: Connect varied drawings through recurring color families.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied colors consistently where possible; introduce an outside color when the illustration needs one.
ingredient.scope: Historical illustration palette, not a closed list for every brand application; core identity colors are documented separately.
